communes: S.Julião, N.S. Da Anunciada E S.Maria Da Graça

blurb.text: A Setúbal Peninsula DOC on mostly light, sandy soils. Its reds must be at least two-thirds Castelão and its whites are mainly Fernão Pires. It also allows rosé, semi-sparkling, sparkling and liqueur wines.
